from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal case cause or category (案由) the document belongs to")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted judgment documents."""
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
